scope: A separately authored synthetic OOXML template contains three nested body repeats, merge fields, a simple table and a bookmark. The bounded expansion, retained ownership and two PDF text outputs were independently inspected; this is not a general Word compatibility or accessibility result.
schema: Open XML SDK 3.5.1 reported zero errors for the independent input, preserved document and expanded document; validator DLL SHA-256 4126071233c70310683c0fa0b65648bbd34839afa7b0a2309fba13c22501ddec.
independentReader: LibreOffice 24.2.7.2 420(Build:2), Ubuntu 24.04, writer_pdf_Export, pinned Noto fonts, image sha256:a3aaef646226d406fc2b511462beb0359f4cd8859d775f404bd8f137dfd5f644; Poppler 25.03.0 pdftotext -layout on the host.
result: The preserved XML contained the three nested repeat tags and their original IDs. Expanded XML had no repeat wrappers and retained 21 ordered blocks, including three distinct matched bookmark IDs and names. WordNet and LibreOffice PDF extraction both recovered the same 21 expected values in order, including current-item, enclosing-item and root-scope values. Empty child collections emitted no leaf content.
earlierAttempts: A focused deep-note test initially failed with Template.MissingValue: an outer clone evaluated an orphaned note after its inner repeat was replaced. The implementation now processes only notes still referenced by that clone; the regression retains the multi-level values and checks distinct note identities.
limitations: These scratch artifacts are not committed fixtures; the source generator, probe and checker reproduce the observation. No licensed Word execution, accessibility, native typography, cell repeat or exact-commit/package/runtime qualification is claimed.
